changes.comment: Live preview: headings, lists, checkboxes, links, quotes, rules, fences and images render inline while the caret's line shows its markdown; Mod+E switches a tab to Reading and back, a status-bar menu reaches Source, and Settings sets the default view for new tabs. Frontmatter is edited as YAML and folds to a tag strip when the caret is elsewhere; tags are chips that search on click and complete on #.
